sahneler.metin: This ship capsized at the dock, and 844 people died.
It happened in minutes, in water only twenty feet deep.
So how does a ship sink at its own pier?
The Eastland was already top-heavy and known to list.
After the Titanic, new rules added lifeboats high on its decks.
That extra weight up top made it even less stable.
As 2,500 passengers crowded one side, it simply tipped over.
A safety rule made the ship more dangerous.

aciklama:
On July 24, 1915, the SS Eastland rolled over at its dock on the Chicago River, killing 844 people. Extra lifeboats added after the Titanic made an already top-heavy ship even less stable.
